The '''National Solaran Writers Award''' is a Solaran literary award named in the extracted source material for [[Jane Pensworth]].

== Source Role ==

The source lists the award in Pensworth's infobox but does not say when she received it, who administered it, or whether the award existed during her lifetime or was later attached to her reputation.

This draft therefore preserves the award as an open Solaran literary institution rather than defining its rules, prestige level, or full recipient list.

== Canon Limits ==

The award should not be used to infer a ministry, writers' union, publishing guild, or state cultural program until a dedicated Solaran cultural-institutions pass confirms those details.
